extension.summary: Plezy-style native Plex interface for Kodi
extension.description: Local UI preview derived from PM4K, using native Kodi playback.
Complemento no oficial de Plex para Kodi
extension.disclaimer: This add-on is not supported by Plex
Este add-on no está respaldado por Plex
Dieses Addon wird nicht von der Firma Plex Inc. unterstützt
extension.news: - Every screen now follows the Plezy TV design: detail screens, player, search, settings, profiles, music and photos - Review fixes for 4:3 displays, navigation and focus; templates re-render on first start - Plezy-style home: collapsed icon rail that opens over the content, spotlight with logo, metadata and summary - Hub rows: Plezy cards with rounded artwork, white focus ring, row icons; the active row leads, others dim - Plezy palette everywhere, Material Symbols icons and a new default "Plezy" button theme
